skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the components of socio-economic research, the process of building and basic content at each step of the research process.
Understand and apply basic qualitative and quantitative data collection methods in socio-economic sciences.
Analyze qualitative and quantitative data using appropriate tools such as SPSS and NVivo.
Identify and collect data on research problems.
Have ethical awareness in research and a serious, honest attitude towards scientific research.
Design independent research approaches suitable for research objects and independently implement research in socio-economic fields.
Work in groups, present and defend personal viewpoints, take responsibility for content and research methods.
